text.tspan: Probes: the kubelet asks three questions
the others wait until it passes
check only the container, never the DB
NOT restarted; back when it passes
Types: httpGet (200–399) · tcpSocket · exec (exit 0) · grpc. Defaults: period 10 s · timeout 1 s · failureThreshold 3.
Startup budget = failureThreshold × periodSeconds (30 × 10 s = 5 min). Startup keeps failing → restarted.
Liveness that checks the database → every pod restarts at once during a DB slowdown.
